name: westwood_online_upgrade_api_event_sink_on_session_query_finished
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeApiEventSink::OnSessionQueryFinished completes session-detail query rows, removes pending result rows, optionally appends connect status, and refreshes list mode.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
